title: Iterating Arrays Check
description: Index for vs for...of on arrays.

questions.prompt: What does `for (const x of ["a", "b"])` assign to `x` on the first iteration?
questions.explanation: `for...of` yields values. Indexes come from a classic `for` with `i`.

questions.prompt: Which loop header visits every dense index of `arr`?
questions.explanation: Start at 0 and stop when `i < arr.length`. Using `<=` reads one past the end.

questions.prompt: You need both index and value. What is the straightforward tool?
questions.explanation: Index loops pair `i` with `arr[i]`. `for...of` does not provide indexes by default.

questions.prompt: After `const out = []`, which append matches the lesson (no `push` yet)?
questions.explanation: Writing at `out.length` appends and grows length by 1.
